_doc: Which Claude Code hooks (hooks/hooks.json) omp runs: the turn hooks through omp/hook-bridge.ts (`bridged`) and the session-end family through omp/stop-bridge.ts (`bridgedSessionEnd`: Stop chain plus the SessionEnd/SubagentStop/PreCompact ingest). hooks.json stays the single wiring source (order, matchers, timeouts); this file only says which scripts are safe to run from omp and why the rest are not. Bridged hooks run with ATLAS_MANDATES=off because omp/mandates.ts owns the mandates with omp-native reachability. Every Stop/SessionEnd/SubagentStop/PreCompact payload carries a transcript_path that scripts/omp_transcript.py produced (the omp session file converted to a Claude-shaped transcript JSONL in a plugin temp dir): omp/stop-bridge.ts converts BEFORE any Stop hook runs, because the gate and the ingest hooks re-read the converted transcript. Conversion failure degrades individual hooks fail-open; no broken adapter may wedge or block a session. The bridged Stop chain self-limits: at most 3 consecutive block refusals per session (the counter resets on session start/switch and on a passing Stop), and a hook block whose reason repeats while the payload's stop_hook_active is set never blocks again.

events.PreToolUse: tool_call (main and subagent sessions); an omp task batch is run once per item as a Claude Task dispatch
events.PostToolUse: tool_result (payload carries tool_response = stringified result content, transcript_path and is_error; omp-minted mcp__<server>_<tool> names of the hooks.json connector servers are re-split to mcp__<server>__<tool>)
events.Stop: session_stop (main only): omp_transcript.py converts the omp session file BEFORE any hook runs, then the five Stop hooks all run in hooks.json order (capture hooks must run even when the gate blocks); the first {decision: block, reason} becomes the omp session_stop result {decision: block, reason}, not plain context. The payload mirrors Claude Code's Stop payload, including last_assistant_message: the text blocks of session_stop.last_assistant_message joined by newlines (omitted when the event carries no text), which completion_gate.py condition (n) reads
events.SessionEnd: session_shutdown on a main session: ingest_session.py spawned detached (never awaited) after transcript conversion
events.SubagentStop: session_shutdown on a subagent session: ingest_session.py spawned detached after transcript conversion
events.PreCompact: auto_compaction_start: ingest_session.py spawned detached (session_before_compact is deliberately NOT used: registering a handler for it disables omp async compaction)

notBridged.todo_capture.py: omp/index.ts mirrors the omp todo tool to the board natively (the board-mirror spawn writes .atlas/.run/todos.json on every todo tool result)
notBridged.atlas_doctor.py: mines atlas_db telemetry written by Claude Code hooks; the omp bridge writes the same run/event/dispatch rows, but the doctor surface is only exercised by the Claude path today
notBridged.worker_report_gate.py: omp subagent sessions never fire session_stop; the report contract is enforced on omp by omp/worker-report.ts (strict outputSchema injected into atlas task items)
notBridged.recall_gate.py: omp/mandates.ts implements the recall gate natively
